title: The ty binary
summary: One standalone executable creates projects (`ty init` asks what the app should have and installs the missing tools; `ty add` grows the app later), runs them in development, builds them and inspects them. `ty preview` is the development server for Tac and Yon. `ty start` serves the published output and never builds it again. `ty handler invoke` runs one controller or worker through the protocol, without any server. It binds controller arguments like the server does, but it skips the route access rules, so keep it a local operator tool. `ty test` compiles and runs the `Test` units of the project in both realms (Tac and Yon). It also reports the public methods of annotated classes that no test case called.
